scope.title: EvidencePack — Analysis of 'Pinterest Predicts 2026 Trend Report'
scope.summary: Create an EvidencePack that extracts, summaries, and catalogs the key trends, category breakdowns, and supporting metrics from the uploaded 'Pinterest Predicts 2026 Trend Report' to support product and marketing decision-making.
objectives: Identify and summarize each trend described in the report.
Extract quantitative metrics and growth percentages (search change figures) shown for each trend.
Map trends to categories (e.g., Fashion, Beauty, Home, Travel, Food & Drink, Celebrations).
Identify primary demographic adopters called out in the report (Gen Z, Millennials, Gen X, Boomers).
Produce a concise executive summary and a structured JSON EvidencePack payload containing the extracted evidence.
in_scope: All content, trend descriptions, and numeric indicators present in the uploaded 'Pinterest Predicts 2026 Trend Report' file (source file).
Categorization of trends and mapping to report-provided demographics.
Extraction of explicit search-change metrics and any stated sourcing/analysis-period information.
Producing structured outputs (JSON, short summary, and list of deliverables) derived solely from the uploaded report.
out_of_scope: Supplementing or verifying report claims with external data sources not uploaded by the user.
Primary data collection or reanalysis beyond extracting the report's stated figures.
Interpretive forecasts or recommendations that go beyond summarizing and structuring the report content (unless explicitly requested).
deliverables: EvidencePack JSON containing structured fields (metadata, trends array, metrics, demographics).
CSV (or table) listing trends, categories, and reported percent-change metrics.
constraints: Work limited to content available in the uploaded report file.
Accuracy depends on the completeness and clarity of the uploaded PDF.
No external validation will be performed unless additional files or permission are provided.
assumptions: The uploaded file ('Pinterest Predicts 2026 Trend Report') is the authoritative source for this pack.
All numeric metrics needed are present and legible in the uploaded document.
stakeholders: Product or marketing team consumers of the EvidencePack
